thread:
people-ops: Heads up team — hiring & org update for Observability/DevEx (long but important). We’ve extended an offer to Nora Patel to join Redwood as Director of Observability & Developer Experience, start date Monday 2026-04-06. Nora's background: SRE/Observability lead at Polaris, built their telemetry pipeline and onboarding flows. She’ll own runbook/alerting platform, onboarding docs, and cross-team DevEx initiatives. She is joining as an IC->manager hybrid role and will partner with Eng-Platform and Eng-SRE on reliability SLAs.

people-ops: Parallel change: Samir Rahman is rotating from Eng-SRE into an interim EngOps lead role to run day-to-day platform ops and help with the handoff. This is an 8-week rotation (4/6 -> 6/1) to stabilize the team while Nora ramps. Hiring plan: we’ll backfill Samir’s SRE IC role (req is posted, recruiter pinged), and start a search for two senior on-call engineers to bulk up pager coverage. Compensation and relocation/remote stipend details are in the HR doc linked below. Please read before Q&A.

people-ops: Key actions this week:
- 4/1 09:00 PT onboarding sync (invite sent) — people-ops, Nora, Samir, Eng-Platform leads
- 4/3 15:00 PT hiring panel planning (interviewers: Anna, Devon, Maria)
- Add runbook owners in the runbooks repo and assign a transition owner for each alert

people-ops: Onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/nora-observability (internal)

anna-liu: huge congrats Nora! excited to have you here :tada:

nora-patel: thanks all — really looking forward. Quick Q: is there a preferred continuity plan for the 2-week on-call overlap with Samir? I can do async shadowing but want a short plan.

samir-rahman: @nora-patel I’ll do a 10-day overlap on the most noisy pages and leave a transition checklist. Will put a short schedule in the runbook repo.

devon-park: congrats — happy to join interviews. Also FYI infra asked for the access list for observability dashboards, will add that to the onboarding doc.

maria-garcia: will run candidate scheduling for the SRE backfill. Prefer blocking mornings for interview loops.

kevin-choi: ops heads-up — please provision read/write to metrics cluster for @nora-patel and add her to #observability-admins.

ashley-m: noted about relocation/remote stipend — people-ops, can you confirm sign-off timeline for the stipend? We need to include in offer docs.

people-ops: @ashley-m yes confirmed. Offer letters include the stipend clause; sign-off done.

eng-managers-bot: Reminder: update your team org chart by Friday so people-ops can publish the new headcount changes.

people-ops: Thanks everyone. Short Q&A — drop questions here or ping me directly. We'll run a live huddle 4/2 11:30 PT for any immediate questions. :ear:
